claim-automerge-skips-stacked.statement: pr-reviewer-automerge does not merge a PR whose baseRefName differs from the repository default branch.
claim-automerge-skips-stacked.falsifier: automergeFilter returns an empty reason for a PR with baseRefName != trunk

claim-pr-reviewer-review-rounds.statement: With the patch, a review after max_review_cycles posts new non-critical findings only as non-blocking notes (no inline threads, no REQUEST_CHANGES), while a critical finding on a changed line still posts inline.
claim-pr-reviewer-review-rounds.falsifier: pr-reviewer pipeline test review_lifecycle_caps_rounds_skips_rebases_and_escalates_critical_findings fails, or a follow-up round posts a non-critical inline comment

claim-pr-reviewer-stack-skip.statement: A push that leaves a PR's own change unchanged (rebase, stack cascade, retarget) is completed as skipped:unchanged-diff without a review.
claim-pr-reviewer-stack-skip.falsifier: the pipeline test round 3 posts a review or runs the harness

claim-pr-reviewer-human-answers.statement: With the patch, when a human resolves or answers the bot's thread on a reviewed PR's last open blocking finding, the daemon records the answer and dismisses the bot's REQUEST_CHANGES without running a review.
claim-pr-reviewer-human-answers.falsifier: sync_human_answers leaves the change request in place after the blocking thread is resolved, or dismisses it while the thread is open
